annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulation postpones application dates of rules for UAS operators and manufacturers, and is binding on Member States.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
annotation.dates_quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: COMMISSION IMPLEMENTING REGULATION (EU) 2020/746 of 4 June 2020 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947
